name: nginx-golang-postgres
services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: /home/user/projets/nginx-golang-postgres/backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    networks:
      default: null
    secrets:
      - source: db-password
        target: /run/secrets/db-password
  db:
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: example
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db-password
    expose:
      - "5432"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - pg_isready
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
    image: postgres
    networks:
      default: null
    restart: always
    secrets:
      - source: db-password
        target: /run/secrets/db-password
    user: postgres
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: db-data
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        volume: {}
  proxy:
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    image: nginx
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 80
        published: "80"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/user/projets/nginx-golang-postgres/proxy/nginx.conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
        read_only: true
networks:
  default:
    name: nginx-golang-postgres_default
volumes:
  db-data:

secrets:

Description: A simplistic commandline todo list.

  -c  Clear all the current tasks
      Can also use clear instead of -c
  -r  Remove the following task numbers seprated by spaces
      Can also use remove instead of -r
  -g  Get the current tasks

  -v  Get the tool version

   todo -r 1 3
   todo add Another Task
   todo list
   todo -g
   todo -c
   todo clear
